title: Occupation ends Nov 10 under lockdown; campaign announced continuation
scope: Budapest SZFE campus occupation; subsequent campaign activity not assumed to be a mass gathering
summary: At a Nov 10 press conference students said lockdown rules required leaving university buildings but that their protest would continue; a Dec 14 student interview confirms they left the buildings Nov 10 and continued digitally/through other means. No distinct qualifying November street gathering is verified here.
